usage.query:
SELECT
  COALESCE(NULLIF(cm.session_id, ''), CAST(cm.rowid AS TEXT)) AS sessionId,
  CAST(CASE WHEN cm.gmt_create < 1000000000000 THEN cm.gmt_create * 1000 ELSE cm.gmt_create END AS INTEGER) AS timestamp,
  COALESCE(
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cm.model_info) = 1 THEN json_extract(cm.model_info, '$.model_key') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cm.model_info) = 1 THEN json_extract(cm.model_info, '$.modelKey') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cr.extra) = 1 THEN json_extract(cr.extra, '$.modelConfig.key') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cr.extra) = 1 THEN json_extract(cr.extra, '$.model_config.key') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cs.preferred_model_info) = 1 THEN json_extract(cs.preferred_model_info, '$.model_key') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cs.preferred_model_info) = 1 THEN json_extract(cs.preferred_model_info, '$.modelKey') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cs.preferred_model_info) = 1 THEN json_extract(cs.preferred_model_info, '$.preferred_model') END,
    CASE WHEN json_valid(cs.preferred_model_info) = 1 THEN json_extract(cs.preferred_model_info, '$.preferredModel') END,
    'qoder-agent'
  ) AS model,
  COALESCE(
    NULLIF(cs.project_name, ''),
    CASE WHEN substr(cs.project_uri, 1, 7) = 'file://' THEN substr(cs.project_uri, 8) ELSE cs.project_uri END,
    cm.session_id,
    'unknown'
  ) AS project,
  CAST(MAX(0, COALESCE(json_extract(cm.token_info, '$.prompt_tokens'), 0) - COALESCE(json_extract(cm.token_info, '$.cached_tokens'), 0)) AS INTEGER) AS inputTokens,
  CAST(MIN(COALESCE(json_extract(cm.token_info, '$.prompt_tokens'), 0), COALESCE(json_extract(cm.token_info, '$.cached_tokens'), 0)) AS INTEGER) AS cachedInputTokens,
  0 AS cacheCreationInputTokens,
  CAST(COALESCE(json_extract(cm.token_info, '$.completion_tokens'), 0) AS INTEGER) AS outputTokens,
  0 AS reasoningOutputTokens
FROM chat_message cm
LEFT JOIN chat_record cr ON cr.request_id = cm.request_id
LEFT JOIN chat_session cs ON cs.session_id = cm.session_id
WHERE cm.role = 'assistant'
  AND json_valid(cm.token_info) = 1
  AND trim(cm.token_info) NOT IN ('', '{}')
  AND cm.gmt_create IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY cm.gmt_create DESC, cm.rowid DESC
